podcast.title: Collaborator with The Chemical Brothers
podcast.body: "Bezorton" (likely Bez from Happy Mondays) was one of the many prominent figures in 90s British rock who collaborated with The Chemical Brothers on their albums. "los chemical brothers en sus iscos tienen colaboraciones con... Bezorton."

srcs.episode: The Chemical Brothers. Padres de la cultura BIG BEAT

podcast.title: Control Room Couch Traded for Drugs
podcast.body: Along with Shaun Ryder, Bez famously traded the control room couch from the recording studio for drugs during the sessions for their fourth album in Barbados. "And the couch from the control room at the studio disappeared because Sean and Bez traded it for drugs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Repeated Arm Injuries in Barbados
podcast.body: During the Happy Mondays' trip to Barbados to record their fourth album, Bez broke his arm three times. "Bez from the band broke his arm on this trip three times."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
